verdict.rationale: Airwallex's Hosted Payment Page and Drop-in Element are documented as single integrations that support multiple payment methods and auto-adjust fields by method/country, and Billing/Invoicing references 160+ local payment methods — implying broad wallet and local-method coverage. However, the evidence never explicitly names Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, or BNPL as supported methods. Missing for 10: explicit documentation listing Apple Pay/Google Pay/BNPL support, and independent confirmation of these specific methods working end-to-end.
